We then evaluated each trained model in a few-shot in-context learning (ICL) setting on two logical reasoning tasks: Formal Logic Deduction (FLD) and bAbi, which do not require commonsense or world knowledge.
We conducted experiments to analyze whether models trained solely on a single programming language generalize better to pure logical reasoning tasks compared to models trained on natural language.
